title: A meeting with a clear continuation
description: The recording and the transcript help prepare the minutes. Decisions, owners and deadlines can be checked against the original remarks.

blocks.text: Someone at a meeting wants to listen to the other person instead of trying to write down every word. A recording and a transcript make it possible to come back later to a specific agreement.

quote.text: I have a consulting job and talk to many people from different companies. I have mild ADHD, so this app has been tremendously helpful. I can be present in the moment with a client without having to worry about taking notes at the same time.

blocks.text: Tie the remark you found to the audio and assemble a separate draft of the outcome: the decision, the owner, the deadline. The participant confirms these details before they are passed on.

A name recognized wrongly should not automatically become a new participant. A missing deadline stays a question rather than a guess. The value is measured by the time it takes to reach a verified outcome, not by the length of the transcript.
